title: Behaviour-driven development (BDD): Gherkin and a shared language

videos.script: Lesson fifteen's tests were in Python. Joana could not read them, and she is the one who knows the rule. {{python}} Behaviour-driven development starts from that problem. Describe what the software should do, in examples, in the words the business already uses. {{behaviour}} Given an order of thirty-six reais. When the customer uses the code PIPOCA. Then the order costs thirty-one. {{gherkin}} Joana can read that, and correct it. A tool called behave can run it, once each sentence is matched to a few lines of code. {{steps}} After that, a new rule arrives as a new scenario. ESTREIA takes ten reais off. It fails, because the rule is new. One line of code, and it passes. {{estreia}} The tool is the easy part. The value is the conversation that produced the examples, and that is where a tester's questions belong. {{end}}
